messages:
kevin_rt: heads-up: after the gated kernel-selector roll (partial rollout @ 03:00) we see a host-side P99 regression on tokenization+streaming for mixed-script payloads. Metric spike at 03:14 correlates w/ selector flips to 'low-latency' on several hosts.

anya_perf: saw it too. Quick numbers from microbench: baseline tokenize+framing = 2.1ms, after selector = 3.7ms, writev_count up ~3x. Flamegraph points at `tokenize_utf8::slow_path` and an increased syscall cluster around `grpc::writev`.

kevin_rt: bisected to the selector heuristic that favors low-latency kernel when recent tail < 15ms. That heuristic toggles a boolean disabling prefix-coalesce in the preparse shim.

anya_perf: likely root cause: disabling prefix-coalesce increases fragmentation of framing and prevents KV cache key normalization -> KV hitrate drops ~3% on long-tail requests.

samira_docs: can we add a short note in the selector docs about tokenization interactions? Also, we need gating tests for mixed unicode (emoji+CJK+latin). This slipped through.

ops-bot: deployed patch ff: preserve-prefix-merge flagged true on 10% canary at 2026-03-23T03:45:12Z (deploy-id: dpl-8233). Monitoring metrics.

kevin_rt: mitigation plan: 1) short-term feature flag to preserve prefix-merge when request entropy > threshold OR emoji_ratio > 0.04. 2) add per-request telemetry: `writev_count`, `tokenizer_path`, `kernel_variant`. 3) CI microbench with mixed scripts to catch regressions.

anya_perf: I'll draft a conservative change to the selector: compute estimated_tokenizer_penalty + syscall_estimate and pick throughput when combined delta > 0.5ms. Will run 5m bench and attach results.

samira_docs: I'll update docs and add the unicode test vectors to the selector gating checklist. Also adding a small note in the release notes about potential host-side tokenization interactions.

kevin_rt: owners: anya -> perf bench + heuristic PR, samira -> docs + gating tests, me -> rollout coordination & telemetry. Target: canary validate in 90m.

ops-bot: canary metrics: writev_count/request down 65% after ff on canary hosts. No errors.

anya_perf: bench attached showing writev_count drop and KV hitrate recovers to baseline on canary. Will open PR with telemetry and heuristic change.

kevin_rt: schedule 15m sync at 05:00 to decide gradual rollout. Thanks all.
